MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (3 Tesla or less): SFG ≤ 10 T/m; maximum B1+rms of 1 microtesla; Limit total active scanning to 10 min; Followed by a wait time of 5 minutes; Any transmit coil may be used.
Device configuration during MRI: Therapy OFF.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
